column5: One canonical Datum-consuming uint64 state implements source AND/OR/XOR identities, NULL skipping, signed EvalInt raw-bit conversion, unsigned preservation, fallible noninteger rejection, same-kind partial merge, reset, exact UInt result, XOR departure-before-arrival sliding, and source-native 8-byte spill encoding. aggregate/runtime/mod.rs dispatches all three BIT kinds through fold_bit_values for Database aggregate folding. Window dispatch, descriptor-driven EvalInt coercion, typed chunk evaluation/output, executor memory tracking, and the architecture-dependent Go spill format outside a same-host round trip remain explicit gaps.
